Path: fleet decision — objectui can publish a release | 缺项 (the `Spec Range Floors` gate) | none

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p1` · `domain:ui` · `area:devpath` · `pm:queue`. A release blocker

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/package.json` (`"@objectstack/spec": "^17.3.0"`) ⇒ `domain:ui`. Rationale: app-shell imports four symbols at runtime that the published `@objectstack/spec@17.3.0` does not contain (`predicateSlotRefusal`, `structuralConditionRefusal`, `EVALUATED_EXPRESSION_SOURCE_REQUIRED`, `EvaluatedExpressionSchema`; measured with `npm pack`). The nightly `Spec Range Floors` alarm is red on `main` (2026-09-26 and 2026-09-27). `changeset:publish` runs the same gate, so **the next objectui release is cancelled until this is repaired**. A broken publish path ⇒ **p1**. The fix is one range and one changeset.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-28T01:13Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments).

**Execution notes.**
1. Raise app-shell's declared range to `^17.4.0`, the first spec version exporting all four, and the range `@object-ui/types` already declares. Add a `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/app-shell`.
2. Re-run `pnpm check:spec-floors` over a full build. Record 0 `floor-too-low` findings, and name any other package the full build surfaces.
3. The likely origin (PR objectui#10672) is not needed for the fix. ⛔ Do not revert anything to lower the floor.

Claim: PM loop round 10 — `domain:ui` execution seat 2
Session: `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`
Branch: `claude/issue-10864-app-shell-spec-floor`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-10864`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#2`
File surface:
- `packages/app-shell/package.json`: `@objectstack/spec` goes from `^17.3.0` to `^17.4.0`, per triage `5861605977` item 1.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`: only the specifier the range change moves, regenerated with pnpm, never by hand.
- One `.changeset/10864-…md` for `@object-ui/app-shell` (`patch`).
- Any other package that the full-build `pnpm check:spec-floors` reports `floor-too-low` is raised the same way and listed, per triage item 2.
- ⛔ No revert to lower a floor (triage item 3).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: sonnet` (mechanical round)
Clause-②: no
Why no: a dependency floor rises to the version whose exports the shipped code already imports. No acceptance set or public face widens.
Thread-read: 5861605977
Serial constraints cleared: I read the open-PR file lists at 2026-09-28T01:5xZ, at objectui `origin/main` `b93e245f9` (9 open PRs plus the release PR objectui#5400). None touches `packages/app-shell/package.json` or `pnpm-lock.yaml`. The release PR regenerates and is not a hold.
